empty.performed: No performed studies are waiting for a report.

schedule.heading: Schedule {{study}}
schedule.timeHint: On the hospital's clock, in 15-minute steps.
schedule.dayOutside: Choose a day from today to 90 days ahead.

refused.conflict: Someone changed this study meanwhile. Close this panel to see it as it is now.
refused.notSchedulable: This order can no longer be scheduled: it was cancelled or the study was performed.
refused.gone: This imaging order is no longer on the worklist.
refused.outsideWindow: That time has passed or is more than 90 days ahead. Choose another.
refused.invalidSlot: A study starts on a 15-minute step. Choose another time.

unschedule.done: {{study}} for {{name}} unscheduled. It is back to schedule.

perform.done: {{study}} for {{name}} marked as performed. It now waits for its report.

refused.conflict: Someone changed this study meanwhile. The worklist shows it as it is now.
refused.notScheduled: This study is no longer scheduled: it was moved, performed or cancelled.
refused.gone: This imaging order is no longer on the worklist.

report.heading: Report of {{study}}
report.none: No report has been signed for this study yet.

template.label: Report template
template.hint: Fills the findings with the template, filled in for this study, in place of what they say now. Check what it says before signing.
template.failed: The template could not be read. Try again.

report.templateFilled: Findings filled from the template. Save the draft to keep them.

links.heading: Links to images
links.hint: Images held outside the system, at an https address. There is no image viewer here.
links.label: Label
links.full: A report has at most 10 links.
links.invalid: Enter an https address with no user name, password or access token in it.

report.confirmSign: Signing completes the order, and the report can never be changed. A correction is added as an addendum. Sign now?
report.signed: The report of {{study}} for {{name}} is signed.
report.signedBy: Signed by {{name}} on {{time}}. A signed report is never changed.

addenda.heading: Addenda
addenda.hint: An addendum is signed by you when added, and is never changed or removed.
addenda.empty: Write the addendum before signing it.

refused.signed: This report was signed meanwhile. Close this panel to see it as it is now.
refused.notPerformed: This study is no longer waiting for a report: it was not performed or was cancelled.
refused.gone: This imaging order is no longer on the worklist.
refused.invalidLink: A link is not an https address the system takes. Remove it and add it again.
refused.template: That template is no longer available. Choose another, or write the findings.
refused.incomplete: Write the findings and the impression before signing.
refused.placeholders: A placeholder of the template is still in the report, in double braces. Replace it before signing.
refused.notSigned: An addendum is added to a signed report only.
